Rae (Partnerships): starting SolarisBench EAP thread. NDA signed, partner ready to ship boards next week. Need quick decisions: benchmark matrix, allowed telemetry fields, lab windows, and embargo timing. Keep replies short.

Luca (Eng-ML): propose quick matrix: batch [1,8], seq [128,512,1024], models: rwd-gpt-3b, community-7b-q4. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, sustained tokens/s, GPU mem, and 200-sample quality check. I can run these.

Hannah (Infra): lab access: they'll SSH to our bastion, need 10.5.8.0/24 white-list. I'll stage harness at gs://redwood-eap/solaris/harness-v1.tar.gz. Note: boards default freq scaling will cap long runs, partner offered firmware patch.

Marco (Legal): Solaris asked for hourly telemetry; we want aggregated daily. Also must ban raw request dumps. I'll post NDA amendment by EOD.

Pri (Product): marketplace copy draft in drive. Suggest label "Solaris-Ready". Marketing wants a joint blog 2-3 weeks after stable baselines; partner prefers 1 week. We'll align post-baseline.

ops-bot: perf job queued: sb-2101 (owner: Hannah). CI: https://ci.redwood/runs/sb-2101

Rae (Partnerships): action owners: Luca (runs), Hannah (lab + infra), Marco (legal redline), Pri (marketplace). Timeline: baseline runs in 4 days, firmware test in 6 days, legal redline by tomorrow noon, copy freeze in 9 days. React with :white_check_mark: to confirm.

Hannah (Infra): :white_check_mark: adding firewall rule and upload key.

Luca (Eng-ML): :white_check_mark: will drop prompt set in drive.
